en: Black‑and‑white elevated view of a Central European town bordered by forested hills. The foreground shows leafy trees and gardens, with several 19th‑century buildings featuring ornate facades, mansard roofs, and tall windows. In the middle ground, dense rows of similar historic townhouses and spa‑style buildings fill a narrow valley. The overall impression is of a picturesque spa or resort town surrounded by wooded slopes.
